comparison.objective: Paint a controlled band using an edger whose wheels track a skirting board; candidate transfers an LM block onto a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record maintains pad contact and wheel guidance during a surface-following stroke. Candidate mates two precision support profiles and advances a block across the joint.
comparison.success_condition: Record measures painted coverage, clean cut line, absence of trim paint and tool return. Candidate measures complete transfer, all-ball retention and nondamaging continuous support.
comparison.reason: Guide-wheel surface following and paint deposition do not test bearing-element containment.
